title: A little ember ruff. A crown of fire.
intro: Humble beginnings, spectacular payoff. Blazefang is intentionally hidden: compare the base directly with its actual Godot final stage, Pyremane. The payoff must remain the same bonded wolf.
recommendation: Crown Mantle: the strongest final-stage direction.
reason: The crown changes the whole outline and the base’s little ruff has a clear destination. The first two results are retained as examples of the middle-stage trap. The selected silhouette still needs a consistent family model sheet and rendering style.
